findings.reason: Proof step 4.1 does not establish that each partitioned localization has rapid Fourier decay in every direction: each regularity witness supplies decay only in its own cone. Consequently the implication WF(u)=∅ ⇒ u is smooth is not proved as written. Repair locally by using a finite cover of the unit covector sphere, a common cutoff supported where the finitely many witnesses equal one, and step 3.2 to obtain rapid decay for that common localization on cones covering the sphere before applying Fourier inversion.
